details:
* SECURITY UPDATE: authorization bypass in "auth users" @Group Name parsing
     - debian/patches/CVE-2026-70463.patch: tokenise the "auth users" value with
       conf_strtok() in authenticate.c, imported into util.c and declared in
       proto.h, so a leading comma splits on commas alone and an @Group Name
       entry containing a space is no longer torn in two and its deny rule
       silently discarded
     - CVE-2026-70463
   * SECURITY UPDATE: daemon filter-merge bypass of the module filter list
     - debian/patches/CVE-2026-53786.patch: strip module_dirlen from an absolute
       --filter merge path in parse_filter_file() in exclude.c before checking it
       against daemon_filter_list, so an anchored module-relative daemon rule
       matches, and treat a merge file hidden by the daemon filter as
       non-existent instead of a fatal error
     - CVE-2026-53786
   * SECURITY UPDATE: daemon NULL dereference on a non-directory transfer root
     - debian/patches/CVE-2026-70459.patch: reject a "." or "/." transfer-root
       entry that is not a directory in recv_file_entry() in flist.c, instead of
       dereferencing it as a directory structure pointer, and require
       dir_flist to actually hold an entry in recv_file_list() before trusting
       parent_ndx 0, closing the second route to the same uninitialised
       dir_flist->files[0]
     - CVE-2026-70459
   * SECURITY UPDATE: --delete scope widening via implied-parent reclassification
     - debian/patches/CVE-2026-53789.patch: add is_implied_parent_dir() to
       exclude.c and use it in recv_file_entry() in flist.c to force an implied
       parent directory back to the honest XMIT_TOP_DIR|XMIT_NO_CONTENT_DIR
       encoding, so it lands in FLAG_IMPLIED_DIR and delete_in_dir() cannot
       sweep pre-existing siblings; also covers the synthetic transfer-root
       entry and the legacy protocol < 30 XMIT_TOP_DIR path
     - CVE-2026-53789
